mapper.select: select count(1) from blog_article where author_id = #{authorId} and deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT id, category_id, visibility, published_at, reading_minutes, title, summary FROM blog_article WHERE author_id = #{authorId} and deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY published_at DESC limit #{offset}, #{pageSize};
